summary: Ford Credit Floorplan LLC and Ford Credit Floorplan Corporation, as depositors, filed an 8-K disclosing an October 6, 2026 Underwriting Agreement with the underwriters for an asset-backed notes issuance by Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A, alongside the officers' Form SF-3 certifications. The filing is a routine ABS shelf takedown of floorplan receivables, not a corporate special situation. Deal size, note classes, coupon and pricing were left to the Rule 424(b)(2) prospectus; no premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. Watch closing-date mechanics and collateral performance rather than event arbitrage.
